rows.label: qst650202_msg0001
rows.name:
What kind of a person would stand
around waiting in a place like this?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0002
rows.name:
Everyone connected to Bahn was taken
away by the Superbian army, though...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0003
rows.name: The letter was suspicious too...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0004
rows.name: It might be a trap, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0005
rows.name:
I've been waiting for this moment, mo.
Tora...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0006
rows.name: Who are you, mo?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0007
rows.name: Fumo fumo fumo!

rows.label: qst650202_msg0008
rows.name: Hup!

rows.label: qst650202_msg0009
rows.name: M...my back...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0010
rows.name:
Who are you, mo? Why did you send me
that letter and make me gather Blade
data, mo?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0011
rows.name: Tora... You still don't know, mo?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0013
rows.name: I'm Senzou, mo. Tora's grandpa, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0016
rows.name:
There's no way you're Grandpa Senzou,
mo!

rows.label: qst650202_msg0017
rows.name: Mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0018
rows.name:
D-did you forget your grandpa's voice
and face, mo?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0019
rows.name:
You do look like him, but there's no
way you're the real one, mo!

rows.label: qst650202_msg0020
rows.name: Grandpa was killed by Muimui, mo!

rows.label: qst650202_msg0021
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0022
rows.name:
You don't believe me, mo? I think I'm
going to faint, mo...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0023
rows.name:
Tora... Are you sure he really isn't
your grandpa?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0024
rows.name:
Grandpa can't be alive, and besides,
if you were Grandpa, your handwriting
would be much better, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0025
rows.name:
It's a lingering effect of being shot
by Muimui. My hand doesn't move as
freely as it used to, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0027
rows.name:
That actually sounds kind of
plausible, mo?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0028
rows.name: Even so, I don't believe you, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0029
rows.name:
First Dad, and now Grandpa alive too?
Things can't possibly work out that
conveniently, mo!

rows.label: qst650202_msg0030
rows.name: Mo-mooo...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0031
rows.name: Can't be helped, mo...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0032
rows.name:
This is a last resort, but I have
something that will prove I'm your
grandpa, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0033
rows.name: What, mo?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0034
rows.name:
Please check under the Safroge tree
in Seesuroa Paddies near Fons Maim,
Invidia's capital, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0035
rows.name:
Dig there and look at what you find.
That should make you believe I'm
Senzou, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0036
rows.name: Tora... Shall we go take a look?

rows.label: qst650202_msg0038
rows.name: Master, let's go see, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0039
rows.name: All right, mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0040
rows.name:
But if what we dig up doesn't prove
you're Grandpa, we won't come back,
mo.

rows.label: qst650202_msg0041
rows.name: Very well, mo...

rows.label: qst650202_msg0042
rows.name: Take care, mo.
